# Fixed bound-coordinate candidate qualification binding

This is a source-only adapter for the accepted [46-child plan](../envelope_bound_hoist_qualification_plan/README.md). No runtime release follows from source checks. It reuses the two admitted candidate modules in place, the exact original 18-test whitelist and whole assertions/work, original 27-case recorder at five rates, and the unchanged owned guard/IO/counter/post-exit helpers. The native seven-file and GoJS five-file admitted folders remain immutable. No compiler, module copy, baseline child, profile or timing command exists here.

The two JavaScript execution and finalization blocks are literal copies of their original unit/recorder counterparts. Only metadata binding changes. Parent admission retains real argv, full EOF, zero exit, narrow confirmed resident exit races, primary/cleanup errors and the sampled 1 GiB workload-leader gate. Node uses 192 MiB old space/8192 KiB stack; Go25/parent28-second, log256 KiB/module16 MiB and original recorder caps remain. Sampled RSS is no instantaneous or descendant aggregate ceiling. Each recorder compares its entire output to both same-backend archived references, with exact counters. Cross-target full-state identity remains UNPROVEN.

## Fixed disk ledger

`disk-budget.py` enumerates every permitted output. Ten output caps plus46 logs reserve95,944,704 bytes. The complete ledger additionally reserves all46 claims/parent receipts/accepted and rejected summaries,23 GoJS receipts, seven source copies, binding/index/qualification files, a bounded512-record/1 MiB observation journal and lock. Every slot rounds to64 KiB plus4 KiB metadata; every known directory reserves64 KiB; another8 MiB is retained for allocation overhead. Unused capacity remains reserved even after completion. Unknown files, symlinks and over-cap files stop admission.

Immediately before each future child transaction, a fresh physical `statvfs` sample must cover6,576,668,672 bytes plus the entire remaining DSP ledger, explicitly declared other remaining demand and at least64 MiB for concurrent source/checkpoint writes. A plain Chair coordination JSON must identify the volume, issuance/expiry (at most30 minutes), other demand and that allowance. There is no purgeable/reclaimable credit, distributed reservation or hard filesystem guarantee. The unchanged guard/child internally writes its complete pre-admitted raw transaction; subsequent host publications and the next child each receive a new physical check. Publication refusal preserves earlier partial files, forbids continuation/retry, and reports any additional failure to retain a rejection receipt. An abrupt global disk failure cannot guarantee a new receipt can be persisted.

## Commands held for separate release

```text
python3 -B internal/audio/dsp/testdata/envelope_bound_hoist_qualification_host/host.py admit
python3 -B internal/audio/dsp/testdata/envelope_bound_hoist_qualification_host/source-contract.test.py
# Source freeze only, with a fresh explicitly coordinated record:
python3 -B internal/audio/dsp/testdata/envelope_bound_hoist_qualification_host/host.py freeze NEW_SOURCE_ID COORDINATION_JSON
# NOT RELEASED: one exact next job per invocation, no retry/new ID workaround:
python3 -B internal/audio/dsp/testdata/envelope_bound_hoist_qualification_host/host.py run SOURCE_ID COORDINATION_JSON EXACT_JOB_ID
python3 -B internal/audio/dsp/testdata/envelope_bound_hoist_qualification_host/host.py seal SOURCE_ID COORDINATION_JSON
```

The frozen binding enumerates exact jobs and file caps. After the final publication, an external evidence index must include the final journal bytes; the host never claims a self-hashing append journal. Parent/child receipts remain original raw evidence. Historical baseline compiler executable hashes remain unrecorded. Candidate unselected, existing192k steady RED and all earlier failed attempts remain; the product is **open — awaiting merge**, including later main integration and fresh final-head gates.
